problem: Community managers spend large amounts of labor on routine tasks such as onboarding, board packets and month end financials.
business_model: B2B SaaS and AI agent subscriptions sold to management companies
product_category: AI agents for community association management

founders.name: Haoyu Zha
founders.background_notes: Background not given on the YC page; the Vantaca release calls him a co-founder. Other co-founders are not named in sources found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Applying machine learning to messy management workflows and integrating with property management systems was standard applied ML work, with the hard part being reliability on real tasks.

defensibility.rationale: Value came from workflow integration with management company systems, but nothing sourced shows data or integration lock in at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The leading community association platform, Vantaca, bought it in November 2024 and kept HOAi as a standalone product alongside its in platform assistant.

market_need_then: Management companies were labor heavy, which is the company's own framing. No dated third party demand evidence was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, results focused, positions agents as the next best hire

branding.brand_signature: HOAi Fleet, the branded set of AI agents

brand_strength.rationale: The brand survived acquisition and is used in Vantaca marketing as HOAi Fleet and powered by HOAi, but no press about the name itself was found.

outcome_analysis: HOAi built AI agents for HOA management companies in a niche where the dominant platform was a natural buyer. Vantaca acquired it in November 2024 and kept HOAi as an independent product, and by 2026 the HOAi brand anchored Vantaca's AI offering. Terms, customer counts and funding are not public, so the strength of the company's own traction is unknown.
notes: Funding: Seedtable lists a YC seed in January 2022 with no amount; no other figures found, so no rounds are recorded. Competitor search returned only 2025 and 2026 material; nothing dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Founding year not found.
